compositions: @fluojs/passport + @fluojs/jwt: bearer preset wiring (JwtModule.forRoot + PassportModule.forRoot + providers [BearerJwtStrategy]) admits verified tokens, returns 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer for anonymous, and maps expired tokens to 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token"; scope misses return the canonical 403 envelope

@fluojs/passport custom AuthStrategy: ApiKeyStrategy registered as { name: 'api-key', token: ApiKeyStrategy } authenticates through the same AuthGuard; an unregistered strategy name surfaces as 500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, not 401

@fluojs/passport cookie preset + @fluojs/jwt (global): CookieAuthModule.forRoot owns the single registry (cookie default + bearer registration), CookieManager writes Path=/ Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookies and clears both on logout; missing cookies with requireAccessToken:false resolve to { authenticated: false } for @UseOptionalAuth routes while a mandatory @UseAuth route still rejects, and malformed present cookies always fail
